person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and uses close third-person narration, chiefly alternating focalization between Emira and Alix. Multiple substantial Goodreads passages independently expose external narration with access to their thoughts, while first-person forms in the sample occur in dialogue or free direct thought. Publisher excerpts confirm third person in the opening, and scholarly whole-book analysis explicitly confirms that the alternating perspectives remain third-person narration; they therefore do not warrant ALTERNATING. The only material limitation is that the authorized prose evidence covers the opening, but the interior quotes and whole-book scholarly account resolve that scope limitation.
